Use case: ads-marketing. Create one bright, premium computational-vision website hero BACKGROUND ART, landscape 1920x1080 (16:9). Reference image is an existing DARK point-cloud river/city brand concept that the user explicitly dislikes as TOO DARK. Reimagine its spatial reconstruction as a HIGH-KEY SILVER-WHITE, ICE-BLUE and pale cyan-white environment. This is a new brighter artwork, not a photographic negative or simply washed-out dark image.

Main subject: an exquisitely fine spatial dataset forms a winding river, subtly contoured ground and a small coherent urban district. Tiny precise cool-white / medium ice-cyan sampling points, crisp muted blue geometric connections and a few translucent pale-silver building surfaces create real three-dimensional depth. Concentrate the recognizable scene on the RIGHT half and across the BOTTOM third. A diagonal perspective draws the eye from sparse bottom-left data points toward the larger right-side building cluster. Most buildings should be suggested by point clouds and fine outlines, not an opaque real-estate model. The terrain should feel measured and computational, not a science-fiction machine. Refined studio illumination and micro shadows separate near-white forms; point-cloud lines remain clean visible cyan-blue, not neon glows. River surface is light icy blue, not black. No large dark areas at all.

Composition is designed for navy HTML text: LEFT 45%, upper center and top area must remain calm empty nearly uniform pale ice-white (#f3f8fb), with sparse details only near the bottom. Full bleed and seamless, no framed diagram and no border. Natural volumetric spatial depth without spectacle clutter. Bright but not flat. Cold silver-white and cyan-blue is the ONLY palette, no purple, magenta, black backdrop, warm gold, orange, dark shadows or neon. Thin blue linework must visibly carry the scientific character while respecting extensive airy white space. No text, letters, numbers, logos, code, HUDs, metrics, floating cards, charts, graphical UI elements, watermarks or devices. ONE coherent panorama that looks like a beautifully rendered scientific spatial reconstruction and sophisticated algorithm-company art.
note: Bright brand visual concept generated following feedback that previous homepage was too dark. Not measured algorithm evidence.
